description: This is an abstract class defining the visitor pattern for traversing and operating on various document object model elements within the MigraDoc library. It declares abstract and virtual methods for visiting different document components like shapes, paragraphs, sections, tables, etc.

classes.name: DocumentObjectVisitor
classes.description: An abstract base class implementing the visitor pattern for document objects, providing methods to visit various components of a document model.

methods.name: Visit
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to define how to visit a document object.
